The instruction states: "Given translation/title variance between Greek and Latin forms, we will standardize on 'Oedipus at Colonus' as the English reference associated with the Greek title Oedipus Tyrannus." This is incorrect. "Oedipus Tyrannus" is the Latin title for Sophocles' play *Oedipus Rex* (also known as *Oedipus the King*), whereas *Oedipus at Colonus* is a completely different play with the Latin title *Oedipus Coloneus*. Confusing these two works would lead to searching for the wrong text and obtaining an incorrect answer for the blank. The search should focus on *Oedipus Rex* / *Oedipus Tyrannus*.
